cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：主要的
cards.example_en: Safety is the chief concern when we use the science lab.
cards.example_zh: 我们使用科学实验室时，安全是最主要的考虑。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：中国的
cards.example_en: Chinese tea is served after meals at my grandparents' house.
cards.example_zh: 在爷爷奶奶家，饭后会上一壶中国茶。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.example_en: She has a small circle of close friends at school.
cards.example_zh: 她在学校有一个由密友组成的小圈子。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.example_en: Posters of maps cover the classroom walls.
cards.example_zh: 一张张地图海报贴满了教室的墙壁。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.example_en: My sister moved into college housing the week after graduation.
cards.example_zh: 姐姐毕业后的那个星期搬进了大学宿舍。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.example_en: Contact the teacher if you have a question.
cards.example_zh: 如果有问题，请联系老师。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.example_en: Do not sit on the edge of the desk or it may tip over.
cards.example_zh: 别坐在书桌边上，不然桌子可能会翻倒。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.example_en: I practise English by reading the canteen menu aloud each day.
cards.example_zh: 我每天朗读食堂菜单来练习英语。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：条目；进入
cards.example_en: Write a new entry in your diary.
cards.example_zh: 在日记里写一条新内容。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：短文；作文
cards.example_en: I rewrote the essay after I noticed the conclusion did not match the question.
cards.example_zh: 我发现结论和题目对不上，就把这篇作文重写了。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.example_en: I have a maths exam tomorrow.

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.example_en: The diary proves the existence of a secret tunnel under the old school.
cards.example_zh: 这本日记证明老校舍下面存在一条秘密地道。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：熟悉的

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.example_en: City finance paid for the new school roof this spring.
cards.example_zh: 市里的财政今年春天支付了新校舍屋顶的费用。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.example_en: Parents left messages on the school forum about lunch.
cards.example_zh: 家长们在学校论坛上留言谈论午餐。
